script.text: A prince playing among the market stalls. An interesting use of royal freedom.
A duel table does not need a throne.
Then let the cards speak for you. I am Seto. Show me whether your courage reaches beyond these walls.
Be careful. He has been studying every move since he arrived.
Defeat Seto to finish the opening chapter. His stronger monsters reward careful use of Traps, removal and Tributes.
